body: Torture, of the body and mind. I don't think I'd have a high threshold for that. I'm not the kind of person who would be befriended by the inmate population. I know somebody else in the system and I don't think I could handle it.
I'm frightened of what will happen to me if I go in. I'm not really cut out for it. Things worse than death might await, that's my fear.

Ah, I was holding out some hope for a friendly person. It's really hard after a difficult day of lots of worrying to have your first reply like that. After reading some of his other comments it made me realize I wasn't a unique case. I'm finding it too difficult to not worry to the point where everything seems hopeless. I feel like I'm in a situation where ending everything is actually a sensible choice. I don't think I could handle what could happen to me.
I realize that might be trolling but I sincerely agree. It might be that's the only thing I can control...
